articles.title: At 38, Tim Ream Aims to Anchor U.S. Defense and Ignite a Soccer Revolution at Home
articles.summary: Veteran defender Tim Ream, 38, could be named to the U.S. World Cup roster tomorrow. He believes the 2026 tournament can finally make soccer a major sport in America, inspiring millions of kids.

articles.title: Record-Shattering Spring Heat Wave Scorches Europe, Leaving Multiple Dead
articles.summary: The UK hit 95.2°F on Tuesday, smashing a century-old May record. France and Spain also saw unprecedented heat. At least 11 people died in drownings and heat-related incidents. Scientists link the extreme weather to climate change.

articles.title: Armenia Inks Strategic Pact with U.S., Drawing Kremlin's Ire Ahead of Elections
articles.summary: Armenia signed a strategic partnership with the U.S., including a 27-mile corridor deal. The TRIPP route gives Azerbaijan a direct link to Turkey. Russia, a longtime ally, threatens to hike gas prices as Armenia pivots West.
